app: File Explorer via Shell.Application COM — the shell's document model (object-model twin of windows-explorer-uia)

stack_detection.signature: CreateObject('Shell.Application') succeeds (always present on Windows); Windows() enumerates open Explorer windows with LocationURL

channel_setup: comtypes CreateObject('Shell.Application'); no flags, no permissions, no injection. Same throwaway folder as the UIA cell.

t1_read_text.detail: Folder listing with names, sizes, types in 10.4 ms / 110 bytes / 28 tokens. Display names follow the same hidden-extension rule as the pixels ('alpha', 'beta.md') — the object model mirrors the shell's presentation, consistent with the UIA cell's finding (and it still discloses Type='Document texte').

t2_enumerate.detail: Items() enumerates the complete folder — semantic-only, NO coordinates: like macOS Pages via AppleScript, this channel must be paired with UIA for aiming.

t3_live_value.detail: Created gamma-live.txt on disk; the COM view showed it on re-read (5.1 ms). The model is live, not a snapshot.

t5_blind_action.detail: WRITE path without pixels: SelectItem(beta.md, select+deselectothers+focus) in 8 ms; read back via COM (SelectedItems=['beta.md']) AND cross-verified through the INDEPENDENT UIA channel: exactly one on-screen listitem [selected=True] 'beta.md'. Two structured channels agreeing about a state change neither took a picture for.

measurements.notes: The Windows member of the object-model family, measured in the same class as its siblings: 28 tok vs 974-tok window screenshot (~35x), reads 5-10 ms, writes 8 ms — cf. LibreOffice/UNO 21 tok & 9-109 ms writes (Linux), Pages/AppleScript 21 tok & 73-158 ms (macOS). Windows' twist: the ALWAYS-INSTALLED object model is the shell itself (Shell.Application), not an office suite. The planned Word-via-COM star cell is separately recorded as blocked (windows-office-object-model).

runtime_verification.method: cross-channel: COM-written selection state read back via COM and independently via UIA; PrintWindow capture kept as evidence
runtime_verification.agreement: full three-way agreement (COM write -> COM read, UIA read, pixels)
